profile.headline: Full-stack Developer (React & GoLang)
profile.summary:
• Full-stack – GoLang, Rust, React JS, TypeScript, JavaScript
• Responsive Design – Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, HTML5, CSS3, SCSS
• Mobile – Swift, Flutter
• Database – MySQL, Postres, DynamoDB, Oracle 11g, SQL Server 2008 - 2014, Firebase
• Cloud – AWS, Heroku
• CI/CD - Argo, Jenkins, Github
• Project Management - Agile methodology
• Cybersecurity training at Stanford University Post Graduate program (Ranked in top 5)

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• GoLang/Rust back-end
• AWS Dynamo
• React & TypeScript front-end
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Amazon Dynamodb · React.js · PostgreSQL · Amazon S3

positions.title: Full Stack System Engineer
positions.description:
• Manage/modify/enhance existing in-house ticketing web/mobile tools written in Angular JS, jQuery, and JSP with Oracle DB in the backend.
• Revamp the existing mobile application using React Native (1-year project).
• Develop a token-based push notification to send messages to mobile app users.
• Write a web service using Node JS and GoLang to push/pull data into the internal database from the external network (6-month project).
• Created a utility web tool hosted on the aws EC2 instance using React JS. Used by internal users.
• Created a ETL/ELT process, data modeling, reports for a central data warehouse (SQL Server).
• Created various ad-hoc reports using SSRS and Tableau.
• Improved the SQL query performance in various procedures, which resulted in a faster data retrieval time (in a few seconds vs minutes), so that they can be displayed within the web/mobile application.
positions.insights: Skills: Go (Programming Language) · Java · Oracle Database · JavaScript · AngularJS · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · MongoDB · Node js

positions.title: Sr. Database Developer
positions.description:
•	Complex database/ETL development using SQL Server, SSIS, and SSRS.
•	Develop/support a desktop & web management tool written in C#/ASP.NET, jQuery, CSS, and HTML5.
•	SourceTree, GitLab, RedGate, and other various database tools.
•	Write complex T-SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, and other objects.
•	Performance tuning of slow queries and SQL scripts.
•	Mentor Jr. developers/interns.

positions.title: BI Reporting  and ETL Developer
positions.description:
•	Data migration to Microsoft Azure programming - container, blobs, data factory, data lake, DocumentDB, U-SQL.
•	Maintain/support SSRS reports delivered to the customers over 1,000 locations nationwide daily.
•	Write complex T-SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, triggers, views, and other objects.
•	Design and create table structures for data load and enhanced feature needs.
•	XML data manipulation using XPath and XQuery methods in T-SQL language.
•	C# ASP.NET (Web application for internal use) – JavaScript, CSS, HTML, and jQuery.
•	Excel macro development (VBA) to improve productivity for internal customers.
•	Migration effort to Microsoft Parallel Data Warehouse (PDW) environment

positions.title: Senior Developer
positions.description:
o	Complex T-SQL scripts, stored procedures, functions, & views.
o	XML data manipulation using XPath and XQuery methods available in the T-SQL language.
o	Performance tuning using SQL Profiler tool.
o	C# 2010 - Windows Form and ASP.NET.
o	LINQ to XML, LINQ to Data Set, LINQ to Object
o	Conversion of XSLT reports to SSRS (MS SQL Server Reporting Services 2008) reports.

positions.title: Database Analyst II/ Microsoft SQL Server Report Developer
positions.description:
o	Design features include drill-through, drilldown, charts, matrix, parameterization, and VB coding for more advanced reports.
o	Daily data import to more than one SQL Server instance using SQL Server integration Services. Sources included XML, SQL Server, Oracle, DB2, flat file, and Excel. 
o	Wrote complex stored procedures, triggers and functions.
o	Gathering information for the report requests.
o	Support legacy tools such as MS Access 2003/2007 applications.

positions.title: Engineering Student
positions.description:
o	Data profiling and cleansing using control flow and data transformation.
o	Incorporated Error Redirection during ETL Load in SSIS Packages.
o	Used SQL Server Agent for creating, maintaining and scheduling Jobs.
o	Knowledge of Measures, Cubes, Dimensions, and MDX query.
o	Implemented Data Warehouse on SQL 2005 Server Analysis Services.
o	Created Reports using SQL 2005 Server Reporting Services.
o	Deployment of the reports and data sources for the reports.
o	Developed reports with different types of source: Data set and XML.
